paper.title: LIMO: Less is More for Reasoning

result.summary: 本文挑战了复杂推理必须依赖大规模训练数据的假设，提出 Less-Is-More Reasoning (LIMO) 假说：在预训练已编码丰富领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理可通过少量精心设计的认知过程示范被激发 [abstract][S1.p3]。作者通过多层筛选构建了仅 800 条样本的 LIMO 数据集，并对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行简单监督微调 [S1.p4]。LIMO 在 AIME24 上达到 63.3%、MATH500 上达到 95.6%，超过此前微调模型，且仅使用其 1% 的训练数据 [abstract]。模型还展现出较强的分布外泛化能力，在多样基准上取得 45.8% 的绝对提升，优于使用 100 倍数据训练的模型 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：复杂推理是否真的需要海量训练数据，还是可以通过少量高质量样本激发。作者指出，传统范式基于两个假设——掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，且监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。作者认为这种数据密集型范式可能不再必要，因为现代基础模型在预训练中已包含大量数学内容，挑战已从知识获取转变为知识激发 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).

first, that mastering such complex cognitive processes requires extensive supervised demonstrations, and second, that supervised fine-tuning leads primarily to memorization rather than true generalization.
We argue this data-intensive paradigm may no longer be necessary.
Contemporary LLMs may already possess rich mathematical knowledge, transforming the challenge from knowledge acquisition to knowledge elicitation.

method.text: 论文提出 LIMO 假说：在预训练已全面编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理能力可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程示范而涌现，其前提是模型参数中存在潜在的前置知识，以及能将复杂问题分解为详细逻辑步骤的高质量推理链 [S3.p1]。作者构建了一个多层筛选的数据集：先用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 过滤简单题，再用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 采样 32 次，保留仅成功 1–3 次的问题，得到 2,125 个问题的 LIMO-Pool [S3.SS1.SSS1.p3]。随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按规则评分系统选出每个问题最高分解答，取前 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。训练上，作者对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行全参数监督微调，使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 和 FlashAttention-2，学习率 5.0e-6，余弦衰减，无 warmup，训练 15 个 epoch，batch size 为 64 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: In foundation models where domain knowledge has been comprehensively encoded during pre-training, sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes.
The quality of reasoning chains that precisely decompose complex problems into detailed, logical steps, making the cognitive process explicit and traceable.
Problems that were successfully solved in only 1–3 out of 32 attempts were retained, yielding a refined dataset of 2,125 problems
we employed three state-of-the-art reasoning models—DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and QwQ-32B —sampling multiple solutions from each to generate diverse reasoning approaches.
we selected the highest-scoring solution for each problem, ranked these pairs by quality score, and extracted the top 800 to form the LIMO Dataset.
We fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning on our LIMO dataset.
The training process employs full-parameter fine-tuning with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 optimization and FlashAttention-2.
we utilize a learning rate of 5.0e-6 with a cosine decay schedule.
The model is trained for 15 epochs with a batch size of 64 examples

experiments.text: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 上评估模型 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。分布外评估包括 OlympiadBench、中文多语言基准 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准使用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的小基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
CHMath (2024 Chinese High School Mathematics League), Gaokao (China’s 2024 College Entrance Exam), Kaoyan (Chinese Graduate School Entrance Exams), and GradeSchool
we incorporate multi-disciplinary benchmarks including Minerva (undergraduate-level STEM) and GPQA
We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
For smaller benchmarks (less than 50 problems: AIME24, AMC23, and CHMath), we generate 4 samples (temperature=0.6) and calculate the unbiased pass@1 metric.
These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview
These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples
NuminaMath-100k, a randomly selected 100k subset of NuminaMath-CoT

findings.text: 在域内任务上，LIMO 在 AIME24 达到 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；在 MATH500 达到 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；在 AMC23 达到 96.3%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座的 45.3%；在 CHMath 为 84.2% 对 68.5%，GradeSchool 为 76.2% 对 63.8%；在 GPQA 达到 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 出现明显退化（32.3% 对基座 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。LIMO 在所有基准上的平均性能为 78.1%，超过 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 等基线 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

evidence.quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
On MATH500, LIMO achieves a notable 95.6% accuracy, surpassing QwQ-32B-Preview (89.8%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (85.5%).
LIMO reaches 96.3% accuracy compared to QwQ-32B-Preview’s 83.6%.
On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
Similar improvements are observed on other challenging benchmarks such as CHMath (84.2% vs 68.5%) and GradeSchool (76.2% vs 63.8%).
LIMO maintains competitive performance even on GPQA, where it achieves 70.7% accuracy, close to OpenAI-o1-preview’s leading score of 73.3%.
NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains, while OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%)
LIMO’s carefully curated 800 problems yield superior performance (78.1%)
LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks, substantially outperforming OpenAI-o1-preview, QwQ-32B-Preview, and other baselines.

limitations.text: 作者指出，维持有效性能所需的最小样本量下界仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。此外，作者提到未来工作可以探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: though the lower bound for maintaining effective performance remains an open question.
Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
